answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1318 Country: United States of America Title: Please, tell me the impotance of offering prayer in Masjid and also tell few Prophet (PBUH) saying. Question: Please, tell me the impotance of offering prayer in Masjid and also tell few Prophet (PBUH) saying. Answer ID: 1318 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 595/587=N) According to a Hadith , the reward of a jamat salah has 25 times more virtue than praying alone without jamat , while according to another Hadith it has 27 times: عن ابن عمر قال: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم؛ صلاۃ الجماعۃ تفضل علی صلاۃ الرجل وحدہ بسبع و عشرین درجۃ ۔۔۔ وعامۃ من روی عن النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم انما قالوا: خمس و عشرین الا ابن عمر رضی اللہ عنھما فانہ قال بسبع و عشرین (رواھما الترمذی: 1/52) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
